dish.title: Korean Galbi-Jjim: Braised Beef Short Ribs with Radish and Carrots
dish.description: Bone-in beef short ribs blanched and slowly braised on the stovetop in soy sauce, grated Asian pear, onion, garlic, and ginger until meltingly tender, with chunks of Korean radish, carrots, and shiitake mushrooms in a glossy, sweet-savory sauce. Served with short-grain rice.

recipe_version.title: Korean Galbi-Jjim: Braised Beef Short Ribs with Radish and Carrots
recipe_version.description: Bone-in beef short ribs blanched and slowly braised on the stovetop in soy sauce, grated Asian pear, onion, garlic, and ginger until meltingly tender, with chunks of Korean radish, carrots, and shiitake mushrooms in a glossy, sweet-savory sauce. Served with short-grain rice.

ingredients.name: Korean radish
ingredients.preparation: peeled, cut into 2-inch chunks with edges rounded

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Trim any thick fat caps from the ribs. Grate the pear and onion, mince the garlic, and grate the ginger, then stir them with the soy sauce, brown sugar, mirin, sesame oil, and pepper. Cut the radish and carrots and stem the shiitakes.

steps.title: Blanch the ribs
steps.body: Bring 12 cups water to a boil in an 8-quart stockpot. Add the ribs, return to a boil, and cook 8 minutes. Drain, rinse the ribs, and wipe out any scum.

steps.title: Start the braise
steps.body: Put the ribs in a 6-quart Dutch oven with the soy-pear sauce and 3 cups water. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer over medium-low 1 hour.

steps.title: Skim
steps.body: Skim off as much fat from the surface as you can.

steps.title: Add the vegetables
steps.body: Add the radish, carrots, and shiitakes, pushing them under the liquid. Cover and simmer until the radish and carrots are tender and the ribs pull from the bone, about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Reduce
steps.body: Uncover and simmer, basting the ribs and vegetables often, until the sauce reduces to a glossy glaze, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: When the vegetables go in, combine the rice and 2 1/2 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; rest covered 10 minutes. This runs inside steps 5 and 6 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Pile the ribs and vegetables in a shallow serving bowl, spoon over the glaze, and scatter scallions and sesame seeds. Serve with the rice.
